# Symmetry Audit Limits

This repository studies the quantitative cost of auditing the instantaneous-symmetry assumption behind a three-qubit interaction witness. The authoritative scientific account is organized by topic under science/.

## Essential distinctions

- The exact symmetry/locality determinant invariant and interaction-witness idea are inherited.
- The null includes arbitrary time-dependent two-local Hamiltonians on exactly three qubits with a known bound on the complete operator norm; hidden mediators and additional levels are excluded.
- Universal lower bounds allow arbitrary intrasector nuisance unitaries. Matching attainment is established for the family exp(-i theta ZZZ), not every endpoint.
- Temporal mean, uniform basis-averaged leakage and worst-input leakage are different constraints. The sharp coefficient is a fixed-positive-phase, large-JT asymptotic.
- The audit-shot optimum concerns ordinary parity-definite preparation and parity-only intermediate measurement. It is not an unrestricted coherent-query or Hamiltonian-learning lower bound.
- Endpoint phase estimation, every repeated prefix, reference width, known operations and finite timing are charged. No practical noisy-hardware crossover is established.
- A phase-resolution floor is fixed before data collection; estimates below it return inconclusive. Hard caps hold on every branch, and matched shot scaling concerns the declared resolved-phase class.

## Question routes

- Story, measured quantity and certificate: README.md; science/model.md.
- Principal-block determinant derivative and universal mean converse: science/phase-leakage.md.
- Exact controls, leading constants, bandwidth and fixed observation grids: science/constructions.md.
- General endpoint blocks, finite endpoint tomography, confidence allocation and matched ordinary-shot cost: science/audit-protocol.md.
- Prefix time, reference width, timing bits, classical cost and limitations: science/resources.md.
- Precise inherited theorems and primary comparison: references/related-work.md; references/references.bib.
- Portable finite verification and expected outputs: verification/README.md; verification/run_checks.py; verification/results.json.

The full connected reading route is science/README.md. Read actual hypotheses before transferring a result to a different process or observation model. Numerical matrix checks support stated finite consequences and do not replace the universal proofs.
